_comment: Card enchantments (backlog #12, the engine half of #3; widened by #50). A data-driven modifier attached to ONE card via Card.enchanted_copy() -- the same generic-copy trick upgraded_copy() already uses, just carrying a named effect+value instead of bumping numbers. Combat (or later, the view) reads effect+value rather than special-casing an enchant id per card, the same shape relics.json already uses for team-wide mods. 'wide' is valid, tested data waiting on the card-face + timing-window UI work that #3 still owns -- deliberately not wired into the view here (needs a screen). Every other enchant below has a /core consumer in Combat, covering cost (cheap), draw (keen), exhaust (spent), target/co-op (bonded, generous) and timing (sure, true_eye) -- the spread #50 asked for.

sure.name: Sure
sure.text: This card's timing always lands, even on a fumble.

wide.name: Wide
wide.text: A much wider timing window for this card.

true_eye.name: True Eye
true_eye.text: A good hit on this card lands as a perfect one.

keen.name: Keen
keen.text: Draw an extra card when you play this.

spent.name: Spent
spent.text: Exhausts (leaves the fight) instead of going to your discard pile.

bonded.name: Bonded
bonded.text: Any Block this grants you, your ally gains too.
